prompt: A model keeps formatting product data differently each time. You add three sample inputs with the exact output you want.
tells: three sample inputs with the exact output
why: Input-output examples in the prompt are few-shot prompting.
trap: A system prompt describes the format; examples show it.

prompt: To get emails in the company's voice, the prompt includes two past emails the team loved.
tells: two past emails the team loved
why: Showing samples to imitate is few-shot.
trap: RAG adds facts to answer from; these are style examples.

prompt: A classifier prompt lists 'Refund please → billing' and 'App crashes → technical' before the new message to classify.
why: Labeled examples before the real input are few-shot prompting.
trap: It's a prompt technique, not a Language-service feature.

prompt: A zero-shot prompt gets the tone wrong. Adding a couple of good answers to the prompt fixes it.
tells: Adding a couple of good answers to the prompt
why: Going from zero examples to a few is few-shot prompting.
trap: The fix was examples, not a setting change.

prompt: A model mislabels sarcastic reviews. The prompt now includes three sarcastic reviews with the correct label.
tells: three sarcastic reviews with the correct label
why: Worked examples in the prompt are few-shot prompting.
trap: Sentiment is the task; the technique is adding examples.

prompt: The team has six good input-output pairs and wants better results today, without training anything.
why: Put the examples in the prompt: few-shot. Fine-tuning needs training.
trap: RAG adds facts; these are examples of the task.

prompt: To get product data in the same shape every time, the prompt shows two filled-in examples before the new product.
why: Examples in the prompt are few-shot prompting.
trap: Fine-tuning trains on examples; these are in the prompt.

prompt: A prompt includes exactly one sample question with its ideal answer before the real question.
tells: exactly one sample question with its ideal answer
why: One example is one-shot, a case of few-shot prompting.
trap: It's not real conversation history; it's an example.
